nodes.label: Historical itinerary planner MVP brainstorm
nodes.description: Source document; claims retain their dated/historical/proposed status.

nodes.label: Itinerary as Location array
nodes.description: No separate Itinerary model; saved itinerary is Location[] with trip-day grouping and same-day manual order.
nodes.rationale: Keep the existing data concept simple and reuse one planner for create/edit.

nodes.label: Date-only YYYY-MM-DD scheduling
nodes.description: Nullable scheduledDate enables legacy rows; new planner rows require in-range date keys; order scoped to day.
nodes.rationale: Avoid UTC-midnight conversions shifting selected calendar days.

nodes.label: Autocomplete-selected places only
nodes.description: Three-character minimum, maximum five suggestions, choose selected place before row valid; server structurally validates and does not re-query Places on save.

nodes.label: Itinerary MVP non-goals
nodes.description: Cross-day dragging, route optimization/lines, time-of-day scheduling, persistent drafts and manual fallback excluded.
